value: NAV frequency MONTHLY: each class as of close of business on the last business day of each calendar month, plus each repurchase date, any distribution date, and other Board-determined dates (each a 'Determination Date'); class NAVs calculated separately. Governance: Board-approved Valuation Procedures; pursuant to Rule 2a-5 the Board designated the Adviser (Ares Capital Management II LLC) as Valuation Designee, subject to Board oversight. Methodology: investments valued monthly at fair value (ASC 820-10); Portfolio Funds at NAV practical expedient (latest manager/GP-reported NAV - typically 60+ days lagged - adjusted for capital activity and known events); a proprietary MARKET ADJUSTMENT FACTOR is applied when the S&P 500 moves more than 10% in a calendar month (a 'MAC Event'), based on Ares Quantitative Research Group correlation data, recalibrated until the next reported NAV arrives; idiosyncratic adjustments for IPOs, bankruptcies, M&A and other material events; an independent third-party valuation service reviews the market-adjustment-factor application (see 4.3).
